notes.title: Full Release Available!
notes.content:
The full version 1.0 is available now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/4b14be70bf9e6155c18f9966ee2de35b7a51100c.png


New Map added!
Explore the Glaciers of Mo'Ritz!
30 new levels
2 new bosses
New graphics and artworks!
Fight large numbers of enemies and find your strategy to master this map!


New Fusion Tower Upgrades!


Combine the elements to build powerful Elemental Fusion Towers.
Start with two Elemental Gemstone Upgrades to unlock the fusions.
Check the Towers Almanac for more info.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/40bbac6c216aabc09d59974c3ba7a597ec00a937.png


Combine Fire with Nature to build a Meteor Tower.
Combine Fire with Storm to build a Flamethrower Tower.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/c0ad6d1e01b5b455bd297de5b46931e150102e18.png


Combine Ice with Nature to build a Snowball Tower.
Combine Ice with Water to build an Icicle Tower.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/bca7e75151fc0ab15b52c94ea24aaa0475e4eceb.png


Combine Lightning with Fire to build an Arc Flash Tower.
Combine Lightning with Ice to build a Plasma Tower.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/7b89207bf61bc2d6c44a57968ada72b0a8e0a574.png


Combine Nature with Storm to build a Leaf Tower.
Combine Nature with Water to build a Spider Tower.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/b881f54da6d46c6865d97b9612a40a98525f6d68.png


Combine Storm with Ice to build a Blizard Tower.
Combine Storm with Lightning to build a Thunderstorm Tower.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/fa8aeaa98d491f974541694b1c3068bea2a5f2b8.png


Combine Water with Fire to build a Steam Tower.
Combine Water with Lightning to build a Electrophorus Tower.


Other Changes


Added a new inventory slot.
Added 19 new achievements.
Fixed some wrong item stats.


I hope you have fun with this new update. It's the biggest update yet and the game is now fully released. There will be more content updates and bugfixes in the future.

- brimsel

notes.title: Version 0.5.3.0b is live!
notes.content:
The newest version 0.5.3.0b is available now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/f4bf6999413e4739c4a45da75bb1ec428ffda0b2.png


New Magic Tower Upgrades!
All Elemental Magic Towers can be upgraded to a higher tier.
A door reward is needed to unlock the upgrades.
Enchanted Fire Tower added.
Enchanted Ice Tower added.
Enchanted Lightning Tower added.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/63af2bc951b0f7bce8124fcf85a0dfbc538fd4cc.png


Enchanted Nature Tower added.
Enchanted Storm Tower added.
Enchanted Water Tower added.
Magic Towers are much stronger and more valuable now.


Other Changes:


Added some new Magic Tower sounds.
The drone range numbers of Drone Towers are now shown in the towers info.
Fixed inventory sorting issues. Some items got mixed up and were not sorted properly.
Fixed some inventory performance issues.
Towers now stay selected when upgraded. Base towers can be upgraded much faster this way.
The explosion radius of blocked enemies is now larger. This solves some pathing issues on "Asmo's Fortress".
Enchanted Fire Tower Achievement added.
Enchanted Ice Tower Achievement added.
Enchanted Lightning Tower Achievement added.
Enchanted Nature Tower Achievement added.
Enchanted Storm Tower Achievement added.
Enchanted Water Tower Achievement added.


This updated fixes some small issues and adds some feature requests from players. With the new upgrades Magic Towers are way more interesting for your endgame maze. I am working on alot more upgrade options for Magic Towers right now. Stay tuned and have fun with the new Towers!

-brimsel

notes.title: Version 0.5.2.0b is live!
notes.content:
The newest version 0.5.2.0b is available now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/e4b69cd61759dd504d95d24c2d73f13b7c3a0b3c.png


New Fusion System!
Fuse two double items into a new item of the same category but with a higher grade.
Fusing costs Fusion Stones which can be found in inventory loot chests.
Combine your double items and get stronger!


Other Changes:

Hotkeys for tower upgrades added. Just use the number keys to upgrade towers way faster.
Rebalancing of the Kitsune Shuriken Tower. Upgrade cost reduced from 130 to 70 gold.
Fixed some more pathing issues on Asmo's Fortress.


As promised here are some more inventory features. Combine your items to get better ones. Players asked for tower upgrade hotkeys, so I added them. Upgrading many towers in a short time is way easier now. I hope you have fun with this new update! Let me know what you think by joining our community on Discord!

-brimsel

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/7c9a15b93a0220e1a65c538a970e79eb227f5e45.png

notes.title: Version 0.5.1.0b is live!
notes.content:
The newest version 0.5.1.0b is available now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/91cb60161cb6f9b8d6b1141bd29f7f7c910c6464.png


Speed-Up Options Added!
You can speed-up the game by clicking the buttons at the top right of the HUD or simply press space.
You can choose your own game speed. This improves the pacing of the game alot!


Other Changes:


Pathfinding issues of enemies at Asmo's Fortress were fixed.
Added a Range indicator to drones. Click on a Drone Tower to see the range of it's drone.


This update has a focus on small quality of life features. Alot of players requested an option to speed-up the game and skip idle time. I hope you like the solution and the overall pacing of the game gets improved.

-brimsel

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/7c9a15b93a0220e1a65c538a970e79eb227f5e45.png

notes.title: Version 0.5.0.0b is live!
notes.content:
The newest version 0.5.0.0b is available now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/2b98de8df9071f5ec9b590a1893c90b4cb6c7a13.png


Explore a New Map!
The map "Asmo's Fortress" was added to the game.
This map has new graphics and a totally different layout.
Master your strategies to beat this map.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/facb97a9d592e083cd7b11b77c0ebf55327d6990.png


New Levels and Bosses!
Asmo's Fortress has 30 new levels with new encounters.
New bosses with unique abilities will challenge your maze.
This map has a harder difficulty then the last ones, so get your strategies straight!


Other Changes:

New unlockable inventory slot added!
Achievement "Slayer of The Skeleton King" added
Achievement "Slayer of The Tentacles of Dust" added
Achievement "Legendary Boss Slayer of Asmo's Fortress" added
Achievement "Victory at Asmo's Fortress!" added
Achievement "Legendary Victory at Asmo's Fortress!" added
Achievement "Fast Victory at Asmo's Fortress!" added
Achievement "Fast Legendary Victory at Asmo's Fortress!" added


I hope you have fun with this new map. Asmo's Fortress is much harder to conquer than the last maps. You should have equipped some items to beat it. I've put alot of work into the new boss and map designs. I hope you like it! Feedback and recommendations for balancing are much appreciated. Join our community on Discord to contact me directly!

-brimsel

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/7c9a15b93a0220e1a65c538a970e79eb227f5e45.png

notes.title: Version 0.4.4.1b is live!
notes.content:
The newest version 0.4.4.1b is available now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/c267991002089bf78a5912bfac0413682293721e.png

New Tripple Bomber Tower!
Double Bomber Towers can be upgraded to Tripple Bomber Towers.
They shoot three cannon projectiles at once and do more damage.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/b0c5f0fa7c7e4582eec41e05c115b661b8d61ef4.png

New Howitzer Cannon Tower!
Mortar Cannon Towers can be upgraded to Howitzer Cannon Towers.
They do more damage and have a bigger damage area radius.


Other Changes:

The range of Gatling Balista Towers was nerfed.
Added the achievement "Build a Tripple Bomber Tower"
Added the achievement "Build a Howitzer Cannon Tower"


A Cannon Tower boost was requested by the players. Therefore I added new upgrades to them. Cannon Towers are way more useful in your endgame maze from now on. The Gatling Balista Tower was too strong and got a range nerf.

Make sure to join our community on Discord, if you have feature requests or suggestions regarding the balancing of the new towers.

- brimsel

notes.content:
The newest version 0.4.4.0b is available now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/7c9a15b93a0220e1a65c538a970e79eb227f5e45.png


Join us on Discord!
You have feature requests, bug reports or just want to connect with other players of Rogue Door Defense? Join our community on Discord!
I will share insights about the game and make announcements about new updates in the Discord.
Let's have a dialogue about Rogue Door Defense. Come join us!


Click to join our Discord Server

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/1c81341e88a6963f1b9011c531e35808b2542667.png


New Gatling Balista Tower!
The Gatling Balista upgrade was added to the Double Balista Tower.
This tower doesn't do much damage per shot, but it's firerate is insane!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/ad549f5da51aeba62555a28ba4ac6e502357a4f5.png


Unlockable Inventory Slots!
3 new slots were added to the inventory.
Unlock them by slaying the level 30 boss on each map.
Equip more items and get stronger!


Other Changes:


Added 30 new items to the pool of loot items. These include Sniper Tower and Shuriken Tower upgrades.
Added the achievement "Build a Gatling Balista Tower"
Cost of the Kitsune Shuriken Tower was reduced.
Fixed some wrong crit chance stats in the Sniper Towers.
Minor bug fixes.


This update fixes alot of small issues of the game. I also implemented some requests from the community, like the unlockable inventory slots and the new tower upgrade. There are more new tower updates coming soon.

In order to connect better with the players of the game and to give you a possibility to discuss the game with others, I've started a Discord Server. If you have requests or feedback this Discord is the best way to reach me and other players. There will also be announcements about upcoming updates and insights about the game. I am looking forward to discuss the game with you. Feel free to join our community!

Click to join our Discord Server

-brimsel

notes.title: Version 0.4.3.1b is live!
notes.content:
The newest version 0.4.3.1b is available now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/118eb7ac93fda30ab62c5cd4caf45395329e2d67.png


New Sniper Towers!
Sniper Towers have a massive range adventage.
They are not shooting very fast, but do high damage.
They have a chance to do critical hits with double damage.
Check the Towers Almanac in the main menu to see how to unlock them!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/947529bb4fb52ccb1a804e87c58008531fc063ff.png


New Shuriken Towers!
Shuriken Towers can shoot up to 5 projectiles at the same time
Every projectile hits a different enemy.
They are useful for big groups of enemies or enemies with high movement speed.
Check the Towers Almanac in the main menu to see how to unlock them!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/a8bd6dc597ffad67e22c197bb4477d880bb3a513.png


Changes to Traps!
Elemental Traps are unlocked differently from now on.
The elemental upgrades are no longer found in the door rewards.
The Gemstone Upgrades for the Elemental Magic Towers also unlock the upgrade for each individual Elemental Trap.
For example: Choose the "Unlock Ice Upgrades" Gemstone Upgrade to unlock Magic Ice Towers and Ice Traps.
The descriptions for Elemental Traps in the Towers Almanac are more detailed now.


Other Changes:

Added 6 new Achievements!
Building each of the new towers unlocks an achievement.


Some players requested to remove the trap upgrades from the door reward pool. The upgrades flooded the rewards and chances were low to get the right upgrades. I hope to eliminate some annoying randomness from the game with these changes.

The Sniper Towers and Shuriken Towers don't have loot items yet. New items will come with the next update.

Have fun with the new Towers!

-brimsel

notes.title: Version 0.4.2.0b is live!
notes.content:
The newest version 0.4.2.0b is available now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/c13574921cebb45a78fe15d69426bdc7e12276a0.png


Inventory quality of life changes!
You can scrap items for gemstones.
Items with higher rarity levels give more gemstones when scrapped.
The items in your inventory are sorted and better organized.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/6846b7396e4b0daa5382fdd18ea6198eab5e560c.png


Rebalancing!
The Double Bomber Towers do more damage and have a wider range.
The Mortar Cannon Towers do more damage and have a wider range.
The "Get 1 Life Each Round" Upgrade is no longer available in the heart door pool.
Added a "Get 1 Life Each Even Round" Upgrade to the heart door pool.
Added a "Get 1 Life Each Uneven Round" Upgrade to the heart door pool.
Changed the "Get 10% Gold" Upgrade in the gold door pool to "Get 30% Gold"


Other Changes:


Fixed the pathfinding at the Village of S'Bastia. There was a blocked way at the top left of the map that enemies couldn't pass. They are no longer blocked by this.


I hope you like the new inventory features. If you have feature requests regarding the inventory please contact me in the steam forums. Have fun!

-brimsel

notes.title: Version 0.4.1.0b is live!
notes.content:
The newest version 0.4.1.0b is available now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/7cfbf5cde1898a118ec8b87948db13c66411ce52.png


New Reward Options!
There are new reward options for the "Heart" and "Coin" doors.
The rewards of the "Heart" door were rebalanced.
Alot of upgrades are much stronger now. There are alot of valueable options for your build.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/1464c98beae7987d6ad7e6a84a09a35ae36ae9bb.png


New Challenges!
Some door rewards let you summon walking chest enemies.
Slay them in the next level to get your reward.


Other Changes:


Made some minor adjustments to the last performance update.
Added a 30 seconds countdown to the sell button.


Some players requested a rebalancing of the "Heart" door rewards. The "+1 Life Each Round" reward was the only real option. The other options are much stronger now and there are some new options worth trying.
Selling towers now hast a 30 seconds countdown. I've read alot of feedback about the normal gamemode being too easy, because of the possibility to juggle enemies. It was the main reason I implemented the hardcore mode in the first place. Limiting the ability to sell towers is in my opinion the only solution, while keeping the realtime mazing mechanics of the game. I hope this cooldown improves the gameplay alot. Do you think it's too long or too short? Let me know in the steam forums!

-brimsel

notes.title: Version 0.4.0.0b is live!
notes.content:
The newest version 0.4.0.0b is available now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/48440baf99e645502163f461bae6154a916c37a1.png


New Inventory System!
Equip up to 5 items to get permanent upgrades and boosts.
You grow much stronger each time you play.
Master your builds by choosing the right items for your strategy.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/d5c2614797f0d79fc028894594317cf5d6b7567e.png


130 Unique Items to Loot!
Slay the bosses to claim your loot in the inventory menu.
The items have different rarity levels.
Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic and Legendary items.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/4ae4867ea3289661d59b0f1393b58710604524ed.png


Big Performance Update!
Some players had issues with graphics cards getting loud while playing. This should be fixed!
Also there is a VSync option added to the menu.


Other Changes:


The game modes are now connected to each map.
You can see how to unlock the different modes in the "Start Game" menu.
Rush Mode is now unlocked by slaying the level 20 boss on each map.


Have fun with this big update! I worked pretty hard on it in the last few days. Alot of players requested an option for permanent upgrades in the game. I hope the new loot system will achieve this in a fun way. Some functions are still missing in the inventory menu - like sorting or scrapping items. There is alot to come in the next updates. Please contact me in the steam forums if you find item bugs. There is alot of room for errors in 130 unique items.

Good luck looting some legendary items everyone!

-brimsel

notes.title: Version 0.2.9.0b is live!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/23b994416afb63f887f3d949d31db9c1027f8710.png


New Drone Towers!
Beat the level 10 boss at S'Bastia Village to unlock the Drone Tower Gemstone Upgrade
Drone Towers summon flying drones
Drones follow enemies while shooting at them
Basic Drone Towers can be upgraded to Pegasus Drone Towers
Pegasus Drone Towers can be upgraded to Harpy Drone Towers


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/57c7ac4c57b1af1e1f3f976a2322a9e4a2b2e5cf.png


New Achievements!
Build a Basic Drone Tower to unlock an achievement
Build a Pegasus Drone Tower to unlock an achievement
Build a Harpy Drone Tower to unlock an achievement


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280132/59150cb6cf72968df543751d9a954aced0fdb0ce.png


New Reroll Mechanics!
Two new Gemstone Upgrades to unlock rerolls
You can get 5 rerolls for the door categories or the rewards
Reroll the outcome to master your build
Each level there is a chance to get up to 4 reward choices instead of just 2
Alot of randomness is reduced


Other Changes:


Fixed some performance issues
Some UI changes and improvements
Fixed some enemy navigation problems at S'Bastia Village


Some players requested randomness reductions. I hope this update can improve the gameplay alot and make the game more strategic. The new towers will give you more build options and new mazing strategies. I hope you have fun with this update and the new content!

-brimsel

notes.title: Version 0.2.5.0b is live!
notes.content:
Fixed some issues with the trap achievements
Made the countdown of each level faster to improve the overall pace of the game
Added the Rush Mode


*NEW* Rush Mode:
You can play the Rush Mode once you've beaten the game on Normal Mode. Enemies move 50% faster but have 25% less health.

notes.title: Rogue Door Defense out now!
notes.content:
Rogue Door Defense has officially launched on Steam!

[previewyoutube=swCcKqJY87E;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you to all beta testers and everyone who supported the game with feedback and feature requests!

I hope you have fun with the game!

What's to come...
I'll try to fix any bugs and balance issues as fast as possible. Please let me know if there are any problems.
The next update is on it's way. I plan to finish the next content update as fast as I can, depending on how many problems are found in the first week.

Cheers,
brimsel
